              -nN    Use N terminals (up to 6, calculate size automatically. This option cannot be used with below options)

              -right (dimension)[,dimension]
              -left (dimension)[,dimension]
              -bottom (dimension)[,dimension]
              -top (dimension)[,dimension]
              -spacer (dimension)     space between terminals
                   Where dimension is = (columns)x(rows)
                   ex: 10x10
                   one of the value can also be ommited like 10x*
                   where * is automatically calculated if possible
                   if second dimension is specified then that side is split and second terminal is created.
                   incase of second dimension it can be automatically calculated by using *, ex: 10x10,*
                   second dimension is not allowed for top and bottom
                   NOTE: order of arguments matters
                   if top and bottom specified first then entire row is given to them, if they are specified after left, then margin is left for terminal and then the top and bottom terminal starts
